dashboard.name: Strata
dashboard.intro: How fit each source is to support answers. These are the same measures as the Data readiness page in Strata. Pick a measure date to compare the two.
dashboard.measureDateAbout: Every tile shows the newest measures taken on or before this date. It starts at today.
dashboard.headline: What the measures say
dashboard.headlineAbout: The day's headline, built by the same function as the Data readiness page in Strata.
dashboard.awardRows: Contract-award rows per fiscal year, by dataset
dashboard.awardRowsAbout: Rows per fiscal year. A missing bar means no rows.
dashboard.sourceRows: Rows per fiscal year, by source
dashboard.sourceRowsAbout: Every source's rows in each fiscal year, with exact counts. It is the table for the chart of contract-award rows.
dashboard.links: Share of rows that link, by link
dashboard.linksAbout: Each link with 20 rows or more, as the share of its rows that link. The table of freshness and link counts lists every link with its counts.
dashboard.routes: Share of pages read well, by route
dashboard.routesAbout: The Procurement Plan pages each reading route read without losing their table rows.
dashboard.freshness: Freshness and link counts, by source
dashboard.freshnessAbout: Each source's latest data, how often it updates, how late it is, its link counts and its status.
dashboard.fixes: Fixes ranked by what they would unlock
dashboard.fixesAbout: Ranked by how many projects each fix would add evidence to, as on the Data readiness page.
dashboard.projects: Projects it would add evidence to
dashboard.notes: Source: Strata's data readiness measures in strata.ops.

footer: Strata is an independent demo built on World Bank open data. It is not a World Bank product, and the World Bank has not reviewed or endorsed it.
